changelog.why: Row 14 - an arrangement that is a real served word but not today's answer gets its own sentence, and a sentence a player reads is copy. It reaches the Game through the Mode's config slice, never an import, so the Game still sees nothing but its payload and context.

Row 15 - a themed day bakes the theme's SLUG, and the Tamil a player reads for it lives here. A category name is player-facing copy, so it is never baked into a dataset where correcting it would need a rebuild.

changelog.change: Added the Home, Daily, and end-of-session strings.
changelog.why: Row 13 - the first player-facing screens; every string a player reads lives here, never inside a component.
Row 7 - player-facing text keyed by stable slug, separate from app-config identifiers; entries land as UI rows add labels.
